# dr_libs

`dr_wav.h` (v0.14.6), `dr_flac.h` (v0.13.4), and `dr_mp3.h` (v0.7.4) are single-header decoders by David Reid, from <https://github.com/mackron/dr_libs> at commit `dfe8377631000664666519fdb83da193fd8037f4`.

Each header offers a choice of public domain or MIT No Attribution (MIT-0). Both are compatible with this project's GPL-2.0-or-later license. The license text is at the bottom of each header. `dr_mp3` is based on minimp3.

Oscilline decodes a file the player supplies, downmixes it to stereo, and resamples it to 44100 Hz. These headers are not game data.
